title: Xuanwu's Ambition
next_chapter_hook: The Xuanwu Sect Master's overbearing voice echoed through the ruins: 'Chen Ji is dead, and his chess game ends with my Xuanwu Sect!' He didn't know that in the depths of those ruins, a pair of calm eyes was coldly watching him. On the chessboard of fate, the confrontation of Chapter 703 had just begun.

text.content:
In the depths of the temporal rift, those eyes that had been dormant for years finally opened completely.

Han Lie sat up slowly, and the meridians throughout his body crackled with sounds—the signs of封印多年后重新苏醒的征兆。His lips curled into a cold smile, his eyes glittering with excitement intertwined with killing intent.

'Chen Ji...' he murmured the name, his voice hoarse yet carrying an icy chill, 'So you've been feigning death all along. Very well, very well. This time, I'd like to see what other tricks you have up your sleeve.'

He stood up and walked step by step toward the exit of the temporal rift. With each step, his aura rose higher. The Xuanwu Sect's unique霸道真元 surged within him. After years of sealing, his cultivation had not regressed; instead, that life-and-death crisis had elevated him to an even higher level.

'I've waited for this day for a very long time.'

dialogue.content:
Outside the temporal rift, the elite disciples of Xuanwu Sect were already in formation. Seeing Han Lie emerge, the leading Elder hurried forward: 'Young Sect Master, you've finally awakened! The Sect Master has been waiting for you.'

Han Lie straightened his robes, his cold expression deepening: 'Tell him not only have I awakened, but I also have a grand gift for him.'

His gaze turned toward the distant horizon—that was the direction of Tianqing Sect. The arc of his lips grew increasingly sinister: 'Useless trash Chen Ji, your chess game... it ends now.'

With one stride, his figure vanished on the spot, leaving only a howling gust of wind behind.

text.content:
Meanwhile, at the Tianqing Sect ruins.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. The Tianji Record fragments in his hand trembled violently, and those prophetic visions surged endlessly through his mind—three pieces he had carefully nurtured, all uprooted at the same moment. Splashing blood, desperate screams, and those distinctive玄色道袍 of Xuanwu Sect...

His pupils constricted sharply.

The Mo Xiansheng within the Tianji Record seemed to sense something and whispered: 'Young Master, your Heavenly Fate Value is fluctuating.'

Chen Ji closed his eyes, the fury threatening to erupt churning in his chest. He rarely experienced such emotions, but this time... this time was different. These pieces were key nodes in his multi-year scheme, each one having cost him countless心血.

'I'll remember this.' he silently recited. When he opened his eyes again, that fury had been perfectly concealed, replaced by bottomless coldness.

'Han Lie... Xuanwu Sect...' His voice was soft, yet carried bone-deep chill: 'You'd better pray, pray that I can't find you.'

The Xuanwu Sect's purge came more fiercely than anticipated.

When the news reached the Tianqing Sect ruins, Chen Ji was standing on a broken stone tablet. Before him, several surviving pieces knelt on the ground, covered in blood, their eyes overflowing with fear.

'Master...' The leader's voice trembled, 'We... we failed to hold... all three pieces were removed, the intelligence network suffered heavy losses, and the Xuanwu Sect also...'

Chen Ji remained silent, simply watching him.

The man swallowed hard, continuing: 'The Xuanwu Sect Master personally gave the order, saying... saying your scheme was nothing special. Also saying...'

'What?'

'That you're just trash, that even if you scheme and plot, before absolute strength you're merely a jumping clown...'

Before he could finish, an invisible pressure descended abruptly. Those cultivators discovered to their horror that the air around Chen Ji seemed to solidify, a suffocating killing intent rising madly.

But in the next instant, that killing intent receded like a tide. Chen Ji turned around, gazing at the distant horizon, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Trash? Jumping clown?'

He laughed softly—that smile was more chilling than any anger.

'Very well, very well.'

choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value, use the Tianji Record to foresee every move of Xuanwu Sect. If they want to play big, let them witness what it means to have flawless strategy. Temporary losses are merely the beginning of a longer game.

text.content:
The fragments of the Tianji Record slowly turned in Chen Ji's hand, line after line of golden text appearing on the yellowed surface.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, immersing his consciousness into those characters. Images began forming in his mind—Xuanwu Sect high-level conspiracies, specific plans targeting his pieces, even Han Lie's next moves were crystal clear.

Heavenly Fate Value: -5

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: 'Young Master, you have now seen every move of theirs. The next step is seeing how you place your pieces.'

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold light flickering within: 'I see it. Han Lie is coming in person, wanting to witness my pathetic collapse with his own eyes.'

He gazed into the distance, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable dominance: 'Since he wants to watch a show, I'll give him a show he'll never forget.'

dialogue.content:
He turned to the remaining pieces, his voice steady: 'Go spread the word. Say that Chen Ji is still alive. Three days later, on these ruins, we will settle accounts with Xuanwu Sect.'

'Master?' The几个人 exchanged bewildered glances, not understanding why he would willingly expose his location.

Chen Ji's lips curved slightly—a dangerous smile: 'Doesn't Han Lie want to see my pathetic state? Then I'll give him a surprise. Let him know...'

His tone suddenly turned icy: 'What it means to hide one's fangs while wearing a sheep's skin.'

choices.description: Since Xuanwu Sect wanted to see his pathetic state, let them see what the real Chen Ji is capable of. Expose part of his strength, publicly humiliate Han Lie, let them know that the trash title was merely an illusion.

text.content:
Chen Ji no longer endured.

He walked slowly toward the edge of the ruins, each step seeming to fall upon some invisible rhythm. The surrounding cultivators watched in amazement—this disciple called trash, this menial servant, his气场 suddenly so powerful, as if he were an entirely different person.

'Since Xuanwu Sect so desperately wants to see me,' his cold voice carried in all directions, 'let them come.'

An aura exploded outward—that pressure far exceeded what any menial servant should possess. Those cultivators who had looked down on him instantly changed expressions, gazing at this young man in disbelief.

'This... what cultivation is this?!'

Chen Ji ignored their shock, his gaze already fixed on the distant horizon. There, a black mass of Xuanwu Sect disciples was approaching, at the head of which was the smug Han Lie.

'Trash Chen Ji,' Han Lie's voice dripped with mocking sarcasm, 'I heard you haven't died yet? Perfect, I'll personally send you on your way!'

Three days passed in an instant.

Above the ruins, Han Lie stood proudly, behind him a black mass of Xuanwu Sect elite. His gaze swept the surroundings, a disdainful smile curling his lips: 'Where is Chen Ji? Didn't you say we'd settle accounts today? Chicken out?'

The disciples behind him erupted in laughter, the sound echoing through the ruins.

At that moment, a figure emerged slowly from the depths of the ruins.

Chen Ji remained in his usual indifferent demeanor—menial servant's robe, faded cloth shoes, even a sickly pallor on his face. But when he spoke, the entire battlefield's atmosphere shifted.

'Han Lie.' His voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears: 'Three days' time, how much have you uncovered?'

Han Lie narrowed his eyes, his smile widening: 'Uncovered how you used those pieces to scheme step by step? Unfortunately, those pieces are all dead now.'

Chen Ji nodded lightly: 'Three pieces, in exchange for your life.'

Han Lie's expression darkened, then he burst into laughter: 'What did you say? In exchange for my life? Trash, you're overestimating yourself!'

dialogue.content:
Han Lie stepped forward, his overbearing aura pressing toward Chen Ji like a mountain.

'Chen Ji, I admit you have some skill,' his voice carried a hint of amusement, 'hiding your fangs for so many years, even I was fooled by you. But you made one critical mistake—you shouldn't have played your petty tricks in front of me.'

He approached step by step, each step pressing down on Chen Ji's heart: 'Now, I want you to understand—before absolute power, any scheme and trickery is a joke!'

Before the words finished, he threw a punch. The拳风 roared, carrying the might to scorch mountains and boil seas, directly toward Chen Ji's face.

The surrounding cultivators gasped—that was Xuanwu Sect's ultimate technique 'Xuanwu Heaven-Suppressing Fist', said to be capable of shattering mountains when mastered to its limit!

Yet Chen Ji merely tilted his body slightly, and that seemingly ferocious punch brushed past his cheek, not even stirring a strand of hair.

'So this is absolute power?' Chen Ji's voice was flat: 'Han Lie, your vision is limited indeed.'

text.content:
Han Lie's face turned ashen, killing intent blazing in both eyes.

'Good! Good! Good!' He repeated the word three times, 'Let's see how long you can dodge!'

He struck again—this time no longer probing, but going all out. Fist shadows filled the sky, true essence surged like an ocean, the entire ruins trembling beneath his aura. The watching cultivators scrambled backward, faces full of terror.

Yet Chen Ji still stood at his original position, neither dodging nor retreating.

Only when that fist was about to land on his chest did he slowly raise his hand.

It was a seemingly withered palm, gently pressing against Han Lie's fist.

'Bang!'

A dull thud.

Han Lie's mountain-shattering punch was actually caught steadily by that withered palm, unable to advance even an inch.

'This...' Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, his face full of disbelief.

Chen Ji raised his head, and those eyes that had been lowered finally met Han Lie's gaze. There was no anger, no mockery—only bottomless tranquility.

'Han Lie,' his voice was soft, yet seemed to come from the Nine Abyss: 'You just said, before absolute power, any scheme and trickery is a joke?'

He smiled faintly: 'Then let me show you what true absolute power is.'

The words fell, and a terrifying aura exploded from within him—like a dragon sleeping for ten thousand years finally awakening. The air trembled, the earth groaned, even Han Lie's pride in his Xuanwu True Essence retreated before this aura.

'This... this is impossible!' Han Lie惊恐地发现 he couldn't move at all.

Chen Ji released his hand, pushing lightly.

Han Lie's body flew backward like a severed kite, crashing heavily against a stone pillar dozens of zhang away, blood spurting profusely.

The entire ruins fell into deathly silence.

choice.prompt: One fist defeated the enemy, but the true enemy still lurks in the shadows observing. Chen Ji can choose how to conclude this confrontation—

choices.description: Strike while he's down, cripple Han Lie and humiliate the Xuanwu Sect. Let everyone see who the real废物 is! This humiliation must be deeply etched into memory.

text.content: Chen Ji gave Han Lie no chance to breathe. His figure flickered, and the next moment he had already appeared before Han Lie. A palm descended, seemingly gentle yet carrying power that could change heaven and earth. 「No!」 Han Lie desperately tried to dodge, but found his body completely unresponsive. 「Bang!」 Han Lie's body was slammed directly into the ground, creating a massive crater in the ruins. Blood spurted from his mouth, every bone in his body shattered by that single palm. Chen Ji looked down at Han Lie in the pit, his voice calm: 「Is this the absolute power you spoke of?」 He crouched down, speaking word by word: 「The废物 has never been me.」 The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples were completely terrified. Their invincible Young Sect Master, now lay in the pit like a dead dog, utterly defenseless. 「Do you want to know too?」 Chen Ji rose, his gaze sweeping over the trembling Xuanwu Sect disciples. 「Your Young Sect Master, before me, is less than废物.」 No one dared speak, not even daring to breathe loudly. Chen Ji lightly brushed the nonexistent dust from his robe and turned toward the depths of the ruins. Behind him lay a battlefield of dead silence and widespread shock.

result_nodes.text: Stop at just the right moment, leaving suspense
result_nodes.description: Since the goal is achieved, there's no need to go overboard. Keep Han Lie alive as a living example, making the Xuanwu Sect cautious. More importantly, let hidden enemies be unable to gauge how many trump cards remain.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May be exposed for still holding back
result_nodes.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, preventing enemies from acting rashly
result_nodes.risk_hint: Han Lie may stage a comeback

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his palm and stood still, watching Han Lie in the pit. Han Lie struggled to raise his head, the intense pain almost causing him to faint, but his eyes still burned with unwilling fury: 「You... you wait... I won't let you off...」 「I know.」 Chen Ji nodded, his voice terrifyingly calm. 「That's why I'm keeping you alive.」 Han Lie froze. Chen Ji crouched down, meeting his gaze: 「Han Lie, you're more useful alive than dead. Let everyone in the Xuanwu Sect see what their proud genius looks like before me.」 He stood up, his voice carrying across the area: 「Today's events are merely a lesson. If the Xuanwu Sect comes looking for trouble again, it won't be just a few broken bones next time.」 With that, he turned and left, his silhouette stretched long in the sunset. The Xuanwu Sect disciples looked at each other, but none dared pursue. Today's battle had completely shattered their image of 「废物 Chen Ji」, replaced by an unfathomable, terrifying existence.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to leave the ruins, an even more powerful pressure descended abruptly. 「Well played the tiger hiding its claws, well played the flawless strategy.」 An aged yet vigorous voice echoed from the void, carrying undeniable authority. The Xuanwu Sect disciples immediately knelt, their faces drastically changing: 「Greetings, Sect Master!」 Chen Ji paused, slowly turning around. A figure descended from the sky, landing at the edge of the pit. He appeared an ordinary old man in plain gray Taoist robes, but the moment he appeared, the very air in the ruins seemed to freeze. Xuanwu Sect Sect Master, Ling Yuan. He glanced down at the dying Han Lie in the pit, a barely perceptible disgust flickering in his eyes, then raised his gaze to Chen Ji. 「Chen Ji,」 his voice carried authority without anger, 「you've surprised me.」 Chen Ji's expression remained calm: 「Sect Master过奖.」 「No,」 Ling Yuan shook his head, a cold smile curling his lips. 「That wasn't praise. I wanted to tell you, your scheme... is indeed exquisite. If that idiot Han Lie hadn't stirred the waters, you might have caused even bigger waves.」 He walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step seeming to tread on Chen Ji's heart. 「Unfortunately, you've met me. Those pieces you call chess pieces are merely ants in my eyes. Your carefully woven chess game is merely a child's plaything.」 He stopped three feet from Chen Ji, looking down from above: 「Now, let me show you what a real chess game looks like.」

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice echoed through the ruins, carrying endless mockery. 「Who do you think you are? Just a废物 who got lucky. The Tianji Record chose you? That only proves even the Tianji Record can make mistakes.」 He raised his hand, pointing at the scattered cultivators behind Chen Ji: 「These people, you think they'll follow you? Laughable. If our Xuanwu Sect is willing, they'll be corpses by tomorrow.」 He then pointed at Han Lie lying in the pit: 「You think you defeated him? No, you lost. You exposed your trump cards. From now on, you have no secrets.」 Finally, he pointed at Chen Ji himself: 「And you, a creature less than an ant, dare play chess with me?」 His laughter echoed through the ruins, sharp and wild: 「Chen Ji, I'll give you a chance. Kneel, submit to our Xuanwu Sect, and I may consider giving you a complete corpse. Otherwise...」 He didn't finish, but the unspoken meaning made the surrounding temperature plummet. Chen Ji watched him silently, his expression unchanged. 「Finished?」 Ling Yuan hesitated. Chen Ji lightly flipped open the Tianji Record in his hand, the text on the fragment glowing faintly: 「Sect Master Ling Yuan, I have a question for you.」 「What question?」 Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze fixed directly on Ling Yuan's eyes: 「Do you really think... you've already won?」 In that moment, the air in the ruins seemed to freeze.

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, and that surge of气势 that had been about to erupt suddenly withdrew.

Ling Yuan froze for a moment, then sneered: "What? Scared? A waste is a waste. Even if you have some strength, it's still nothing more than that."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, his expression terrifyingly calm. He stared at Ling Yuan, and a faint smile actually curved his lips: "The Sect Master is right. I'm merely a废物, how would I dare oppose the Sect Master?"

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, seemingly trying to discern the truth in his words.

Chen Ji continued: "Today's matter is a private grudge between myself and Han Lie, unrelated to the Xuanwu Sect. Since the Sect Master has come in person, I should naturally give you this face."

He stepped back, assuming a posture of concession: "This ruins land, I'll yield it to the Xuanwu Sect. Farewell."

Ling Yuan said nothing, only watching coldly as he departed.

Only when Chen Ji's figure vanished into the depths of the ruins did Ling Yuan冷哼一声: "Smart of you to know your place."

But what he didn't know was that the moment Chen Ji turned around, the killing intent in his eyes burned more intensely than ever before.

"Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji's voice echoed in his heart, "The humiliation you gave me today, I will engrave it in my heart. The day my布局 is complete, that will be the day your Xuanwu Sect is destroyed."

The Tianji Record in his hand pulsed with warmth, as if responding to his killing intent.

This round, he had lost a city. But the chess game remains undecided—who wins, who loses, is still uncertain.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji watched quietly as Ling Yuan departed, a faint smile playing at the corners of his lips.

Ling Yuan's mockery still echoed in his ears—those words about "废物," "小把戏," "蝼蚁"—each syllable carved into his heart. The surrounding wandering cultivators dared not make a sound.

Just then, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Young master, your Heavenly Fate value is fluctuating intensely."

Chen Ji made no reply, only gently stroking the cover of the Tianji Record. Those mocking words, that contempt, that disdain...

"I remember." He recited silently in his heart.

He raised his head, gazing toward where Ling Yuan had departed. The setting sun painted his shadow long across the ground. His face held no anger, no resentment—only a depthless tranquility.

"Ling Yuan," his voice was soft, yet seemed to carry some indescribable power, "You think you've won?"

He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record in his hand, the curve of his lips growing more pronounced: "What you don't know is that your so-called chess game... from the very beginning, has been within my calculations."

The Tianji Record glowed faintly, as if responding to his words.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of praise: "Young master, you have grown."

Chen Ji made no reply, only standing quietly amidst the ruins, watching the残阳 on the horizon.

Although the Xuanwu Sect's purge had been partially halted, Ling Yuan's ambition had been thoroughly exposed. And more importantly... he had finally found Ling Yuan's weakness.

"This time," his voice echoed through the ruins, "I will not give you any chance."

He turned to look at those surviving wandering cultivators, his voice calm yet firm: "From this day forward, you are no longer helpless chess pieces. You are my people—Chen Ji's people. Whoever dares to touch you..."

A sharp killing intent flashed in his eyes: "那就是与我陈机为敌。"

The wandering cultivators exchanged glances, then knelt one after another: "愿追随主人！"

Chen Ji nodded, then turned to walk into the depths of the ruins.

The setting sun's afterglow fell upon him, dyeing his silhouette golden. That figure seemed solitary yet carried an unsettling resolve.

Although the Xuanwu Sect's threat had been temporarily lifted, Ling Yuan's shadow still hung over the entire Tianqing Sect. And Chen Ji knew—the real battle was just beginning.

He gently翻开 the Tianji Record, new text appearing before his eyes—those were new knowledge imparted by Mo Xiansheng, about Ling Yuan's weaknesses, about the Xuanwu Sect's secrets, about the key to this chess game...

"Ling Yuan," his voice carried a chill, "Since you want to play, I will play this game to the end."

The Tianji Record slowly closed, and Chen Ji's figure vanished into the depths of the ruins.

And on the distant Xuanwu Sect Main Peak, Ling Yuan stood atop the clouds, overlooking the direction of the entire Tianqing Sect. A cold smile curved his lips: "Chen Ji... you cannot escape my palm."

What he didn't know was that in the depths of those ruins, a pair of calm eyes was coldly watching him.

On the chessboard of destiny, the showdown in Chapter Seven Hundred and Three was just beginning.

And the name of the victor had already been determined.

text.content:
The Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly in Chen Ji's hand as Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his mind: "Young master, the objective for this scroll has been completed. You have gained a new ability—'Heavenly Fate Perception.'"

Chen Ji closed his eyes, and a new power flowed through his body. He could clearly perceive the Heavenly Fate fluctuations of everyone around him—those hidden talents, those latent threats—all within his perception.

And more importantly, he sensed a familiar aura—that was Ling Yuan, a deeply concealed enemy, an existence more dangerous than Han Lie.

"He hides very deeply," Chen Ji said in his heart, "But no matter how deep the concealment, it cannot escape the洞察 of the Tianji Record."

He opened his eyes, gazing toward the distant horizon. There, the Xuanwu Sect's banner fluttered in the wind, as if mocking his failure.

But a cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips.

"Let them enjoy themselves for a few more days," his voice was soft, yet carried unmistakable霸 气, "When my布局 is complete, that will be the day they are destroyed."

The Tianji Record rustled, new text appearing before his eyes—those were the objectives for the next scroll, Ling Yuan's weaknesses, the key to this chess game.

Chen Ji watched those words quietly, his eyes flickering with cold, piercing light.

Ling Yuan thought he had won, thought the Tianji Record was nothing special. But what he didn't know was that the true Heavenly Secrets... had never been within his control.

"The next scroll," Chen Ji said softly, "I will let you know what true despair feels like."

The Tianji Record's glow intensified, as if responding to his words. And in that moment, Chen Ji felt his connection with the Tianji Record grow even stronger, as if this mysterious ancient tome was finally beginning to acknowledge his existence.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: "Young master, your growth has exceeded my expectations. Continue with this隐忍 and scheming, and you will eventually stand at the peak of this world."

Chen Ji made no reply, only standing quietly amidst the ruins, watching the残阳 on the horizon.

His布局 continued, his chess game extended. Although the Xuanwu Sect's threat had been temporarily lifted, a greater crisis was brewing in the shadows. And he must prepare everything before that moment arrives.

"Ling Yuan," his voice echoed through the ruins, "The next time we meet will be your死期."

The setting sun fully set, night descended. Chen Ji's figure vanished into the darkness, leaving only a legend behind—a legend about a废物 rising, about calculations that miss nothing.

And in that moment, the Tianji Record's glow was especially dazzling in the darkness, as if foreshadowing an even more magnificent story about to begin.

The Xuanwu Sect Sect Master's arrogant voice echoed through the ruins: "Chen Ji is dead! His chess game ends with my Xuanwu Sect!"

He didn't know that in the depths of those ruins, a pair of calm eyes was coldly watching him.

On the chessboard of destiny, the showdown in Chapter Seven Hundred and Three was just beginning.

Ling Yuan's laughter abruptly stopped. He spun around, gazing into the depths of the ruins. There, Chen Ji's figure was slowly emerging, his face bearing a faint, knowing smile.

"Sect Master," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "Do you truly believe... that I have already died?"

In that moment, Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply. For thousands of years, he had never experienced this feeling—that fear of being outmaneuvered by his prey.

The Tianji Record glowed faintly in Chen Ji's hand, new prophecies emerging. Ling Yuan's chess game had just begun, but Chen Ji's counterattack... was already on its way.
